metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in the United Kingdom increase in February 11-25, 2019 compared to the same period average from 2000-2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (MOD11A1 or MOD11A2) or Landsat with thermal bands - I'll use MODIS MOD11A1 (daily 1km) for both periods - Date 1: February 11-25, 2019 - Date 2: February 11-25 averaged over 2000-2012 (13 years) - Location: United Kingdom boundary 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST has QC bands - should apply basic quality masking - Not about clouds, so mask poor quality pixels 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - LST values are in Kelvin (scaled), typically 250-320K range - Check pixel counts to detect C2 - Check if results are None/NaN for C3 - Compare means: if 2019 > baseline average, answer A; else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const uk = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'United Kingdom')); const geometry = uk.geometry(); // Target period: Feb 11-25, 2019 const targetStart = '2019-02-11'; const targetEnd = '2019-02-26'; // Baseline period: Feb 11-25 for years 2000-2012 const baselineYears = ee.List.sequence(2000, 2012); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS LST const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .select('LST_Day_1km'); // Get 2019 data let col2019 = modis .filterDate(targetStart, targetEnd) .filterBounds(geometry); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images found: ${size2019}`); if (size2019 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2019 period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get baseline data (2000-2012) const baselineImages = baselineYears.map(function(year) { const yearStart = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 2, 11); const yearEnd = yearStart.advance(15, 'day'); return modis .filterDate(yearStart, yearEnd) .filterBounds(geometry) .mean(); }); const baselineCol = ee.ImageCollection(baselineImages); const sizeBaseline = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline year-composites: ${sizeBaseline}`); if (sizeBaseline === 0) { console.log('No baseline data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Create mean composites const img2019 = col2019.mean(); const imgBaseline = baselineCol.mean(); // Scale factor for MODIS LST: 0.02 (Kelvin) const img2019_K = img2019.multiply(0.02); const imgBaseline_K = imgBaseline.multiply(0.02); // 4. Check pixel counts const count2019 = img2019_K.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const countBaseline = imgBaseline_K.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 valid pixels: ${count2019}`); console.log(`Baseline valid pixels: ${countBaseline}`); if (count2019 === 0 || countBaseline === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean temperatures const stats2019 = img2019_K.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const statsBaseline = imgBaseline_K.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 mean LST: ${stats2019 ? stats2019.toFixed(2) : 'null'} K`); console.log(`Baseline mean LST: ${statsBaseline ? statsBaseline.toFixed(2) : 'null'} K`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (stats2019 === null || statsBaseline === null || isNaN(stats2019) || isNaN(statsBaseline) || stats2019 < 200 || stats2019 > 350 || statsBaseline < 200 || statsBaseline > 350) { console.log('Invalid temperature values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const diff = stats2019 - statsBaseline; console.log(`Temperature difference: ${diff.toFixed(2)} K`); if (stats2019 > statsBaseline) { console.log('2019 temperature increased compared to baseline.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('2019 temperature did not increase compared to baseline.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
